---
title: "Module 2: Differential Expression (mRNA + miRNA)"
author: "Helen Hoxie"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

**Purpose.** Differential expression with limma-voom
(`DGEList -> filterByExpr -> calcNormFactors (TMM) -> voom -> lmFit -> eBayes`):

1. mRNA, Tumor vs Normal (NAT)
2. mRNA, Late (III/IV) vs Early (I/II) stage, tumors only
3. mRNA, Stage IV vs Stage I, tumors only
4. miRNA, Tumor vs Normal (NAT)
5. Validated miRNA-mRNA target pairs with opposite direction of change (multiMiR)

Tumor vs Normal comparisons include patients contributing both a tumor and a NAT
sample alongside unpaired tumors. Within-patient correlation is estimated with
`duplicateCorrelation` (block = patient) and used in `voom` and `lmFit`.

Genes are keyed by Ensembl gene ID (version suffix removed). Gene symbols and
gene types come from the annotation stored in the GDC count object. Analyses are
restricted to the gene types listed in `config.json: de$gene_types`
(default: protein-coding; `null` keeps all genes).

**Inputs** (relative to `project_dir`): `data/processed/rna_ocscc_se.rds`,
`mirna_ocscc_counts.rds` (Module 0); `master_samples.rds`,
`mirna_sample_map.rds` (Module 1).

**Outputs:**

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `data/processed/gene_annotation.rds` | Ensembl ID, symbol, gene type for analysed genes |
| `data/processed/v_mrna.rds`, `res_mrna.rds` | voom object and results, mRNA Tumor vs Normal |
| `data/processed/v_mrna_LvE.rds`, `res_mrna_LvE.rds` | mRNA Late vs Early |
| `data/processed/v_mrna_4v1.rds`, `res_mrna_4v1.rds` | mRNA Stage IV vs Stage I |
| `data/processed/v_mirna.rds`, `res_mirna.rds` | miRNA Tumor vs Normal |
| `results/DE/*_DE.csv` | full results tables |
| `results/DE/voom_meanvar_*.pdf`, `volcano_*.pdf` | diagnostic and volcano plots |
| `results/DE/miRNAup_mRNAdn_targets.txt`, `miRNAdn_mRNAup_targets.txt` | multiMiR target pairs (evidence-level rows) |

**References.** Law et al. (2014) Genome Biology 15:R29 (voom);
Ritchie et al. (2015) Nucleic Acids Research 43:e47 (limma).


```{r setup}
source(here::here("scripts", "helpers", "config.R"))
source(here::here("scripts", "helpers", "de_helpers.R"))
cfg <- load_config()
start_log(cfg, "Module_2_DifferentialExpression")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(edgeR)
  library(limma)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
})

adj_p      <- cfg$de$adj_p
abs_logfc  <- cfg$de$abs_logfc
gene_types <- cfg$de$gene_types   # NULL = all gene types

de_dir <- proj_path(cfg, "results", "DE")
dir.create(de_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
out_data <- function(f) proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", f)
out_res  <- function(f) file.path(de_dir, f)

n_sig <- function(res) sum(res$adj.P.Val < adj_p & abs(res$logFC) > abs_logfc, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Thresholds: adj.P <", adj_p, "; |logFC| >", abs_logfc, "\n")
cat("Gene types analysed:", if (is.null(gene_types)) "all" else paste(gene_types, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```


## 1. mRNA counts and gene annotation

```{r load_mrna}
rna_se <- readRDS(out_data("rna_ocscc_se.rds"))
master_samples <- readRDS(out_data("master_samples.rds"))

# PAR_Y rows duplicate their chrX counterparts once version suffixes are removed
is_par_y <- grepl("_PAR_Y", rownames(rna_se))
cat("Genes in count object:", nrow(rna_se), "\n")
cat("PAR_Y rows removed:", sum(is_par_y), "\n")

gene_annotation <- as.data.frame(rowData(rna_se)[!is_par_y, c("gene_name", "gene_type")]) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Ensembl_ID = sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(rna_se)[!is_par_y])) %>%
  dplyr::select(Ensembl_ID, Symbol = gene_name, gene_type)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(gene_annotation$Ensembl_ID))

cat("\nGene types (top 8 before filtering):\n")
print(head(sort(table(gene_annotation$gene_type), decreasing = TRUE), 8))

keep_genes <- if (is.null(gene_types)) rep(TRUE, nrow(gene_annotation)) else gene_annotation$gene_type %in% gene_types
gene_annotation <- gene_annotation[keep_genes, ]
cat("\nGenes retained after gene-type filter:", nrow(gene_annotation), "\n")
cat("Symbols shared by >1 Ensembl ID (Ensembl ID remains the key):",
    sum(duplicated(gene_annotation$Symbol)), "\n")

counts_mrna <- as.matrix(assay(rna_se, "unstranded")[!is_par_y, ][keep_genes, ])
rownames(counts_mrna) <- gene_annotation$Ensembl_ID

# Align samples to master_samples (tumor + NAT only)
stopifnot(all(master_samples$barcode %in% colnames(counts_mrna)))
counts_mrna <- counts_mrna[, master_samples$barcode]
cat("mRNA count matrix:", nrow(counts_mrna), "genes x", ncol(counts_mrna), "samples\n")

saveRDS(gene_annotation, out_data("gene_annotation.rds"))

annotate_genes <- function(res) {
  res %>%
    dplyr::rename(Ensembl_ID = Feature_ID) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(gene_annotation, by = "Ensembl_ID")
}

rm(rna_se, is_par_y, keep_genes)
invisible(gc())
```


## 2. mRNA: Tumor vs Normal

```{r mrna_tvn}
de_tvn <- run_voom_de(
  counts      = counts_mrna,
  group       = master_samples$sample_group,
  levels      = c("Normal", "Tumor"),
  coef_name   = "TumorVsNormal",
  meanvar_pdf = out_res("voom_meanvar_mRNA.pdf"),
  block       = master_samples$patient_id
)
v_mrna   <- de_tvn$v
res_mrna <- annotate_genes(de_tvn$res)

cat("Genes tested:", nrow(res_mrna), "| significant:", n_sig(res_mrna), "\n")

saveRDS(v_mrna, out_data("v_mrna.rds"))
saveRDS(res_mrna, out_data("res_mrna.rds"))
write.csv(res_mrna, out_res("mRNA_TumorVsNormal_DE.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p <- plot_volcano(res_mrna, "Symbol", "Up in Tumor", "Down in Tumor",
                  "mRNA: Tumor vs. Normal (OCSCC)",
                  sprintf("N = %d Tumor, %d Normal", sum(master_samples$sample_group == "Tumor"),
                          sum(master_samples$sample_group == "Normal")),
                  adj_p, abs_logfc, label_n = 20, label_logfc = 2, label_by = "t")
print(p)
ggsave(out_res("volcano_mRNA.pdf"), p, width = 10, height = 8)
```


## 3. mRNA: Late vs Early stage (tumors)

```{r mrna_lve}
samples_lve <- master_samples %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_group == "Tumor", Stage_NEL %in% c("Early Stage", "Late Stage"))

de_lve <- run_voom_de(
  counts      = counts_mrna[, samples_lve$barcode],
  group       = samples_lve$Stage_NEL,
  levels      = c("Early Stage", "Late Stage"),
  coef_name   = "LateVsEarly",
  meanvar_pdf = out_res("voom_meanvar_mRNA_Late_v_Early.pdf")
)
res_mrna_lve <- annotate_genes(de_lve$res)
cat("Genes tested:", nrow(res_mrna_lve), "| significant:", n_sig(res_mrna_lve), "\n")

saveRDS(de_lve$v, out_data("v_mrna_LvE.rds"))
saveRDS(res_mrna_lve, out_data("res_mrna_LvE.rds"))
write.csv(res_mrna_lve, out_res("mRNA_LateStageVsEarlyStage_DE.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p <- plot_volcano(res_mrna_lve, "Symbol", "Up in Late Stage", "Down in Late Stage",
                  "mRNA: Late Stage vs. Early Stage (OCSCC)",
                  sprintf("N = %d Late, %d Early", sum(samples_lve$Stage_NEL == "Late Stage"),
                          sum(samples_lve$Stage_NEL == "Early Stage")),
                  adj_p, abs_logfc, label_n = 20, label_logfc = 1, label_by = "t")
print(p)
ggsave(out_res("volcano_mRNA_LvE.pdf"), p, width = 10, height = 8)
rm(de_lve)
```


## 4. mRNA: Stage IV vs Stage I (tumors)

```{r mrna_4v1}
samples_4v1 <- master_samples %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_group == "Tumor", Stage_Grouped %in% c("Stage I", "Stage IV"))

de_4v1 <- run_voom_de(
  counts      = counts_mrna[, samples_4v1$barcode],
  group       = samples_4v1$Stage_Grouped,
  levels      = c("Stage I", "Stage IV"),
  coef_name   = "StageIVVsStageI",
  meanvar_pdf = out_res("voom_meanvar_mRNA_StageIV_v_StageI.pdf")
)
res_mrna_4v1 <- annotate_genes(de_4v1$res)
cat("Genes tested:", nrow(res_mrna_4v1), "| significant:", n_sig(res_mrna_4v1), "\n")

saveRDS(de_4v1$v, out_data("v_mrna_4v1.rds"))
saveRDS(res_mrna_4v1, out_data("res_mrna_4v1.rds"))
write.csv(res_mrna_4v1, out_res("mRNA_StageIV_Vs_StageI_DE.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p <- plot_volcano(res_mrna_4v1, "Symbol", "Up in Stage IV", "Down in Stage IV",
                  "mRNA: Stage IV vs. Stage I (OCSCC)",
                  sprintf("N = %d Stage IV, %d Stage I", sum(samples_4v1$Stage_Grouped == "Stage IV"),
                          sum(samples_4v1$Stage_Grouped == "Stage I")),
                  adj_p, abs_logfc, label_n = 35, label_logfc = 1, label_by = "t")
print(p)
ggsave(out_res("volcano_mRNA_4v1.pdf"), p, width = 10, height = 8)
rm(de_4v1, counts_mrna)
invisible(gc())
```


## 5. miRNA: Tumor vs Normal

```{r mirna_tvn}
mirna_counts <- as.matrix(readRDS(out_data("mirna_ocscc_counts.rds")))
mirna_sample_map <- readRDS(out_data("mirna_sample_map.rds"))

stopifnot(all(mirna_sample_map$barcode %in% colnames(mirna_counts)))
mirna_counts <- mirna_counts[, mirna_sample_map$barcode]
cat("miRNA count matrix:", nrow(mirna_counts), "miRNAs x", ncol(mirna_counts), "samples\n")

de_mir <- run_voom_de(
  counts      = mirna_counts,
  group       = mirna_sample_map$sample_group,
  levels      = c("Normal", "Tumor"),
  coef_name   = "TumorVsNormal",
  meanvar_pdf = out_res("voom_meanvar_miRNA.pdf"),
  block       = mirna_sample_map$patient_id
)
v_mirna   <- de_mir$v
res_mirna <- de_mir$res %>% dplyr::rename(miRNA_ID = Feature_ID)
cat("miRNAs tested:", nrow(res_mirna), "| significant:", n_sig(res_mirna), "\n")

saveRDS(v_mirna, out_data("v_mirna.rds"))
saveRDS(res_mirna, out_data("res_mirna.rds"))
write.csv(res_mirna, out_res("miRNA_TumorVsNormal_DE.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p <- plot_volcano(res_mirna, "miRNA_ID", "Up in Tumor", "Down in Tumor",
                  "miRNA: Tumor vs. Normal (OCSCC)",
                  sprintf("N = %d Tumor, %d Normal", sum(mirna_sample_map$sample_group == "Tumor"),
                          sum(mirna_sample_map$sample_group == "Normal")),
                  adj_p, abs_logfc, label_n = 20, label_logfc = 1.5, label_by = "p")
print(p)
ggsave(out_res("volcano_miRNA.pdf"), p, width = 10, height = 8)
rm(mirna_counts)
```


## 6. miRNA-mRNA validated target pairs (multiMiR)

GDC miRNA counts are quantified per **precursor** (e.g. `hsa-mir-21`), whereas
multiMiR stores interactions for **mature** miRNAs (e.g. `hsa-miR-21-5p`). Each
differentially expressed precursor is mapped to its mature miRNAs with
miRBaseConverter (miRBase version in `config.json: mirna$mirbase_version`), and
multiMiR is queried by mature accession (MIMAT). Because precursor-level counts do
not distinguish the 5p and 3p arms, each precursor is assigned to the validated
targets of every mature miRNA it produces. Pairs are therefore precursor-level
candidates, not arm-resolved interactions.

Interactions are restricted to the miRTarBase support categories listed in
`config.json: mirna$support_types` (default `["Functional MTI"]`). Other
categories in miRTarBase are `"Functional MTI (Weak)"`, `"Non-Functional MTI"`
and `"Non-Functional MTI (Weak)"`; some multiMiR rows carry no support category.
Set `support_types` to `null` to keep all rows. The log reports evidence rows per
category before filtering.

*Planned for a later version:* use GDC isoform-level (mature) miRNA
quantification so that DE and target matching are performed per mature miRNA.

```{r multimir}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(multiMiR)
  library(miRBaseConverter)
})

mirbase_version <- cfg$mirna$mirbase_version
cat("miRBase version used for mapping (config):", mirbase_version, "\n")
cat("Most likely miRBase version of GDC IDs (checkMiRNAVersion):",
    checkMiRNAVersion(res_mirna$miRNA_ID, verbose = FALSE), "\n")
cat("\nmultiMiR database:\n")
print(multimir_dbInfo())

# Precursor -> mature name -> mature accession
p2m <- miRNA_PrecursorToMature(res_mirna$miRNA_ID, version = mirbase_version)
colnames(p2m)[1] <- "miRNA_ID"
mature_map <- p2m %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-miRNA_ID, values_to = "mature_name") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(mature_name), mature_name != "") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(miRNA_ID, mature_name)
acc <- miRNA_NameToAccession(unique(mature_map$mature_name), version = mirbase_version)
colnames(acc) <- c("mature_name", "mature_mirna_acc")
mature_map <- mature_map %>% dplyr::left_join(acc, by = "mature_name")

cat("\nPrecursors tested:", nrow(res_mirna), "\n")
cat("Precursors mapped to >= 1 mature miRNA:", dplyr::n_distinct(mature_map$miRNA_ID), "\n")
cat("Mature miRNAs without accession:", sum(is.na(mature_map$mature_mirna_acc)), "\n")
mature_map <- dplyr::filter(mature_map, !is.na(mature_mirna_acc))

support_types <- cfg$mirna$support_types   # NULL = all support categories
cat("\nmiRTarBase support types retained:",
    if (is.null(support_types)) "all" else paste(support_types, collapse = ", "), "\n")

sig_mirna <- res_mirna %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < adj_p, abs(logFC) > abs_logfc) %>%
  dplyr::select(miRNA_ID, logFC_miRNA = logFC, adjP_miRNA = adj.P.Val) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(mature_map, by = "miRNA_ID")
sig_mrna <- res_mrna %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < adj_p, abs(logFC) > abs_logfc, !is.na(Symbol)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Ensembl_ID, Symbol, logFC_mRNA = logFC, adjP_mRNA = adj.P.Val)

# Validated pairs for one direction: miRNAs changing in mir_sign, mRNAs in the opposite direction
query_pairs <- function(mir_sign) {
  mirs  <- dplyr::filter(sig_mirna, sign(logFC_miRNA) == mir_sign)
  mrnas <- dplyr::filter(sig_mrna,  sign(logFC_mRNA)  == -mir_sign)
  cat(sprintf("  precursors: %d (mature: %d) | mRNAs: %d\n",
              dplyr::n_distinct(mirs$miRNA_ID), nrow(mirs), nrow(mrnas)))
  if (nrow(mirs) == 0 || nrow(mrnas) == 0) return(NULL)
  mm <- get_multimir(org = "hsa", mirna = unique(mirs$mature_mirna_acc),
                     target = unique(mrnas$Symbol), table = cfg$mirna$target_table,
                     summary = FALSE)
  evidence <- mm@data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(support_type = dplyr::if_else(is.na(support_type) | support_type == "",
                                                "(none)", support_type))
  cat("  evidence rows by support type (before filter):\n")
  print(table(evidence$support_type))
  if (!is.null(support_types)) {
    evidence <- dplyr::filter(evidence, support_type %in% support_types)
  }
  evidence %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(mirs,  by = "mature_mirna_acc", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(mrnas, by = c("target_symbol" = "Symbol"), relationship = "many-to-many")
}

cat("\nmiRNA up x mRNA down:\n")
pairs_up <- query_pairs(+1)
cat("miRNA down x mRNA up:\n")
pairs_dn <- query_pairs(-1)

summarise_pairs <- function(x, label) {
  if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) {
    cat(label, ": 0 evidence rows\n")
    return(c(rows = 0, precursor_pairs = 0, mature_pairs = 0))
  }
  out <- c(rows            = nrow(x),
           precursor_pairs = nrow(dplyr::distinct(x, miRNA_ID, Ensembl_ID)),
           mature_pairs    = nrow(dplyr::distinct(x, mature_mirna_acc, Ensembl_ID)))
  cat(label, ":", out[["rows"]], "evidence rows,", out[["precursor_pairs"]],
      "unique precursor-target pairs,", out[["mature_pairs"]], "unique mature-target pairs\n")
  out
}
cat("\n")
sum_up <- summarise_pairs(pairs_up, "miRNA up x mRNA down")
sum_dn <- summarise_pairs(pairs_dn, "miRNA down x mRNA up")

write.table(if (is.null(pairs_up)) data.frame() else pairs_up,
            out_res("miRNAup_mRNAdn_targets.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(if (is.null(pairs_dn)) data.frame() else pairs_dn,
            out_res("miRNAdn_mRNAup_targets.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```


## 7. Summary

```{r summary_table}
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Analysis = c("mRNA Tumor vs Normal", "mRNA Late vs Early", "mRNA Stage IV vs Stage I",
               "miRNA Tumor vs Normal",
               "miRNA up x mRNA down (unique precursor-target pairs)",
               "miRNA down x mRNA up (unique precursor-target pairs)"),
  N_Tested = c(nrow(res_mrna), nrow(res_mrna_lve), nrow(res_mrna_4v1), nrow(res_mirna), NA, NA),
  N_Significant = c(n_sig(res_mrna), n_sig(res_mrna_lve), n_sig(res_mrna_4v1), n_sig(res_mirna),
                    sum_up[["precursor_pairs"]], sum_dn[["precursor_pairs"]]),
  Within_Patient_Correlation = c(round(de_tvn$consensus, 4), NA, NA, round(de_mir$consensus, 4), NA, NA)
)
print(summary_df, row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r cleanup_and_session_info}
rm(de_tvn, de_mir, p, p2m, acc, mature_map, sig_mirna, sig_mrna, pairs_up, pairs_dn,
   samples_lve, samples_4v1, res_mrna_lve, res_mrna_4v1)
invisible(gc())
stop_log()
```
